parts.text: We at the Learning to Adapt, Learning with Agency Lab (LaLa Lab) at Saarland University, Germany

are looking for someone with a strong stats background for a two-year postdoc position — in this role, you will conduct independent research within a broader area of technology-enhanced learning and AI in education (very flexible topic-wise, and with your own 20k euro funding that you can freely use).

You will be joining as a prestigious Humboldt Research Fellow, and will be supported by the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation in various ways, with many financial benefits and scientific networking opportunities.

Please see the details here for more info:

We are currently collecting interests in this role without requiring a lot of application documents. If we find a good match, this might result in a direct appointment.
